summary.text: Larry Stutts, a Republican, has represented District 6 in the Alabama State Senate since November 5, 2014, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he studied veterinary science at Auburn University and received his M.D. from the University of South Alabama College of Medicine.
His professional experience includes working as an OB/GYN.
